nvitk.pipes.bbtpy.stage0_download¶

Black-blood stage 0 (download): XNAT → DICOM for VWI_BB (BrainVIEW T1W).

Downloads one BrainVIEW variant per subject (strong > default > weak) into {dicom_root}/{subject}/vwi_bb/.
